_help: The suspicion model (SPEC 9.7). Suspicion runs 0-100 per bot per target; trust runs 0-1 and starts at 0.5.
weights: how much each piece of evidence moves suspicion. 'certain' locks it at 100 for good; 'cleared' locks it at 0.
trust: how much a matching or clashing claim moves trust in the speaker.
windows: seconds. bodyRoomLeave: seen leaving the body's room this long before the report counts.
lastSeenWith: the last sighting of the victim must end within this long before the report to count.
killSlack: 'with me during the kill' is judged over the kill moment plus/minus this.
shadow: someone within shadowRangeTiles of me for this long is shadowing me; rearm after shadowRearm.
thresholds: accuse in chat at or above accuse; vote for the top suspect at or above vote (personalities adjust these in step 3).
